The '''Sith temple on Zigoola''' was a large structure of reddish-black stone situated on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zigoola]], used by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] to hoard [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]].<ref name="TCWWS" />

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] followed the trail of the Sith to Zigoola during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] (using information supplied to Organa by the [[Friends of the Republic]]), and Kenobi was subjected to intense mental attacks emanating from a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] inside the temple. When Bail smashed the holocron, the attacks ceased, and the temple was destroyed, denying the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] the opportunity to study the Sith artifacts.<ref name="TCWWS" />
